# Expressions of any depth are rewritten. The product of two scalars is
# broadcast once before the loop, a scalar on the left of a subtraction is not
# swapped, a fill takes any loop-invariant value, and a shift applies to a whole
# expression.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	for i := range h {
		h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k - a[i]
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(h, h0, 0, len(h), 0, len(h0)) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h1, 0, len(h), 0, len(h1)) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h2, 0, len(h), 0, len(h2)) || _loopvecOverlap(h, h3, 0, len(h), 0, len(h3)) {
		for i := range h {
			h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(h) > 0 {
			_ = h0[len(h)-1]
			_ = h1[len(h)-1]
			_ = h2[len(h)-1]
			_ = h3[len(h)-1]
			{
				_w1 := h[:len(h):len(h)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3, _w4, _w5 := h0[:_count:_count], h1[:_count:_count], h2[:_count:_count], h3[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint16s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3, _c4, _c5 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w4[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w5[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c3)
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c4)
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c5)
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1)
					_v1.Add(_v2).Add(_v3).Add(_v4).Add(_v5).Store(_c1)
					_v6 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c4[_lanes:])
					_v9 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c5[_lanes:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v6.Add(_v7).Add(_v8).Add(_v9).Add(_v10).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v11 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v12 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v13 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c4[2*_lanes:])
					_v14 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c5[2*_lanes:])
					_v15 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v11.Add(_v12).Add(_v13).Add(_v14).Add(_v15).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v16 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v17 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v18 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c4[3*_lanes:])
					_v19 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c5[3*_lanes:])
					_v20 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
					_v16.Add(_v17).Add(_v18).Add(_v19).Add(_v20).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v21 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w2[_i:])
					_v22 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w3[_i:])
					_v23 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w4[_i:])
					_v24 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w5[_i:])
					_v25 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w1[_i:])
					_v21.Add(_v22).Add(_v23).Add(_v24).Add(_v25).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v26, _n := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v27, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v28, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w4[_i:])
					_v29, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w5[_i:])
					_v30, _ := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w1[_i:])
					_v26.Add(_v27).Add(_v28).Add(_v29).Add(_v30).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	_vcInt32s1_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(k)
	_vcInt32s1_2 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(k * m)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, len(dst), 0, len(b)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, c, 0, len(dst), 0, len(c)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			_ = c[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3, _w4 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count], c[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3, _c4 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w4[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3)
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c4)
					_v1.Mul(_v2).Add(_v3.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v1)).Store(_c1)
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c4[_lanes:])
					_v4.Mul(_v5).Add(_v6.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v4)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v9 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c4[2*_lanes:])
					_v7.Mul(_v8).Add(_v9.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v7)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v11 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v12 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c4[3*_lanes:])
					_v10.Mul(_v11).Add(_v12.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v10)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v13 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v14 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w3[_i:])
					_v15 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w4[_i:])
					_v13.Mul(_v14).Add(_v15.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v13)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v16, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v17, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v18, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w4[_i:])
					_v16.Mul(_v17).Add(_v18.Mul(_vcInt32s1_1)).Add(_vcInt32s1_2.Sub(_v16)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	_vcFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(k)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = k - a[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadFloat64s(_c2)
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v1).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadFloat64s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v2).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadFloat64s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v3).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadFloat64s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v4).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadFloat64s(_w2[_i:])
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v5).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_vcFloat64s2.Sub(_v6).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	_vcFloat64s3 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(k)
	{
		_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_vcFloat64s3.Store(_c1)
			_vcFloat64s3.Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_vcFloat64s3.Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_vcFloat64s3.Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_vcFloat64s3.Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_n := _vcFloat64s3.StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b, 0, len(dst), 0, len(b)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2, _w3 := a[:_count:_count], b[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2, _c3 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w3[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c3)
					_v1.Add(_v2).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c3[_lanes:])
					_v3.Add(_v4).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c3[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.Add(_v6).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c3[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.Add(_v8).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadUint32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadUint32s(_w3[_i:])
					_v9.Add(_v10).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadUint32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadUint32sPart(_w3[_i:])
					_v11.Add(_v12).ShiftAllLeft(uint64(n)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func u16(n int, scale uint16) []uint16 {
	s := make([]uint16, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = uint16(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func i32(n int, scale int32) []int32 {
	s := make([]int32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = int32(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	// Several vectors and a tail.
	h := u16(11, 1000)
	test.Merge(h, u16(11, 3000), u16(11, 7000), u16(11, 9000), u16(11, 11000))
	fmt.Println(h)

	dst := make([]int32, 11)
	test.Poly(dst, i32(11, 2), i32(11, 3), i32(11, 5), 7, 11)
	fmt.Println(dst)

	f := make([]float64, 11)
	a := make([]float64, 11)
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float64(i) * 0.5
	}
	test.SubFrom(f, a, 2.5)
	fmt.Println(f)
	test.FillVar(f, -1.25)
	fmt.Println(f)

	u := make([]uint32, 11)
	x := make([]uint32, 11)
	y := make([]uint32, 11)
	for i := range x {
		x[i], y[i] = uint32(i), uint32(i*i)
	}
	test.ShiftSum(u, x, y, 3)
	fmt.Println(u)
}
-- testmain/output --
[31000 62000 27464 58464 23928 54928 20392 51392 16856 47856 13320]
[116 167 230 305 392 491 602 725 860 1007 1166]
[2.5 2 1.5 1 0.5 0 -0.5 -1 -1.5 -2 -2.5]
[-1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25 -1.25]
[0 16 48 96 160 240 336 448 576 720 880]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 5 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

// Depth 4: the histogram merge shape.
func Merge(h, h0, h1, h2, h3 []uint16) {
	for i := range h {
		h[i] += h0[i] + h1[i] + h2[i] + h3[i]
	}
}

// The product of two scalars is computed once, before the loop.
func Poly(dst, a, b, c []int32, k, m int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*b[i] + c[i]*k + (k*m - a[i])
	}
}

// A scalar on the left of a subtraction is not swapped.
func SubFrom(dst, a []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k - a[i]
	}
}

func FillVar(dst []float64, k float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = k
	}
}

func ShiftSum(dst, a, b []uint32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) << n
	}
}
